client_request: Design a responsive mobile dashboard landing screen for a personal finance tracker application with dark mode styling.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Prominently display total portfolio balance and monthly spending trend graph.
2. Include bottom navigation bar with icons for Home, Accounts, Insights, and Settings.
3. Use high-contrast dark theme (#121212 background with vibrant accent colors).
deliverable_text: Mobile UI design mockup export with dark theme typography and bottom nav component hierarchy.
